CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real file-tree directory navigation: is-dir? (portable dirent.h host glue), sidebar entries color-coded dir/file, cd-into-directory on click + a synthetic '..' entry to go back up via new parent_dir_of. Caught and fixed a real absolute-path bug (last_slash<=0 conflating 'no slash' with 'slash at index 0') before shipping, via a new dedicated test suite. v0.84.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
